cities.name: Beijing
cities.gatewaySummary: PEK · PKX · Beijing South · West · Chaoyang
cities.stayDefault: Wangfujing / Dongdan for a compact central first visit
cities.warning: PEK and PKX are different airport corridors; South, West and Chaoyang stations are not interchangeable.
cities.lastNightRule: Move gateway-side only when the confirmed node, departure window or mobility risk outweighs the final city evening.

cities.name: Shanghai
cities.gatewaySummary: PVG · SHA · Hongqiao rail · Shanghai · South · Songjiang
cities.stayDefault: People's Square / East Nanjing Road as a neutral central start
cities.warning: PVG is not SHA; Hongqiao Airport and Hongqiao Railway Station are connected but serve different booked journeys.
cities.oneMoveRule: Usually keep one base unless a gateway-led short stay dominates.
cities.lastNightRule: Move gateway-side only for a very early confirmed departure or unusually high transfer risk.

cities.name: Xi'an
cities.gatewaySummary: XIY · Xi'an North · Xi'an · Xi'an East
cities.stayDefault: Inside or near the City Wall for historic-core evenings
cities.warning: XIY, Xi'an North, Xi'an East and Xi'an Railway Station are separate nodes; copy the full ticketed name.
cities.lastNightRule: Use an XIY buffer only when the confirmed flight window and traveller needs justify it.

cities.name: Chengdu
cities.gatewaySummary: TFU · CTU · Chengdu East · South · West
cities.stayDefault: Chunxi Road / Taikoo Li for central evening access
cities.warning: TFU and CTU create very different arrival chains; Chengdu East is a separate rail anchor.
cities.oneMoveRule: Keep one city base; give outer branches their own time.
cities.lastNightRule: Choose airport-side only from the actual code, departure band and a conservative transfer check.

cities.name: Guangzhou
cities.gatewaySummary: CAN · Guangzhou · East · South · Baiyun · North
cities.stayDefault: Beijing Road / Yuexiu as a central first-visit hypothesis
cities.warning: The railway stations must match the ticket; the city name alone is not enough.
cities.oneMoveRule: Keep one base unless an event or south-side route dominates.
cities.lastNightRule: Airport-side may fit an early CAN departure after terminal and ground-transport recheck.

cities.name: Hangzhou
cities.stayDefault: Hubin / the east shore for West Lake and city access
cities.warning: The airport, East and West stations pull in different directions; West Lake is not one hotel pin.
cities.oneMoveRule: One base works for most first trips.
cities.lastNightRule: Move airport-side only when the confirmed HGH departure and transfer risk justify it.

cities.name: Zhangjiajie
cities.gatewaySummary: DYG · Zhangjiajie West · Zhangjiajie Railway Station
cities.stayDefault: Choose Zhangjiajie city or Wulingyuan from the confirmed sight order
cities.warning: The airport, rail stations, Tianmen Mountain, Forest Park gates and Grand Canyon are separate anchors.
cities.oneMoveRule: At most one deliberate base move; avoid daily ping-pong.
cities.lastNightRule: A city-side final night may reduce risk for an early DYG flight.

cities.name: Chongqing
cities.gatewaySummary: CKG · Chongqing North · West · East · Shapingba
cities.stayDefault: Jiefangbei for a first visit centred on the river and skyline core
cities.warning: North, West, East and Shapingba are not interchangeable; vertical terrain makes map distance misleading.
cities.oneMoveRule: Usually keep one verified low-friction base.
cities.lastNightRule: Move airport-side only for an early CKG departure or substantial mobility and luggage risk.

cities.name: Guilin / Yangshuo
cities.gatewaySummary: KWL · Guilin · North · West · Yangshuo · Mopanshan · Zhujiang
cities.stayDefault: Guilin for gateway nights; Yangshuo town or Yulong River for countryside nights
cities.warning: Yangshuo Railway Station is not in Yangshuo town; railway, road and Li River journeys end at different places.
cities.oneMoveRule: One deliberate Guilin–Yangshuo base move can be rational.
cities.lastNightRule: KWL-side lodging is a departure-risk tool; a Guilin city final night may already be enough.

cities.name: Shenzhen
cities.gatewaySummary: SZX · Shenzhen North · Futian · Shenzhen/Luohu · East · three checkpoints
cities.stayDefault: Futian as a neutral first-trip, business and transport start
cities.warning: Futian Railway Station is not Futian Checkpoint; Shenzhen Station is beside Luohu but is not the border process.
cities.oneMoveRule: Choose one base from the booked border, rail or flight chain.
cities.lastNightRule: Move airport-side only when an early SZX departure or connection risk outweighs the final city evening.
